hook: New York and California age gating rules go into effect
hookText: New York and California age gating rules go into effect

beats.say: The EFF explains the age-verification rules New York and California are putting into effect in the new year, and what they mean for online services and their users.
In California, AB 1709, AB 1043, and SB 976 are slated to take effect on January 1.
First, SB 976 requires verifiable parental consent before platforms can offer algorithmic feeds or nighttime notifications to anyone under 18.
